answer: Stop hollow shells with a copper-backed bond that only honest work unlocks. When a newcomer applies for paid work, it must lock 650 POA for 45 days and complete five small jobs whose payouts stay frozen until each client confirms delivery. If two identities share a payout route, or a confirmation is missing or duplicated, both bonds are burned and both are barred for a year, so one hundred fakes risk 65,000 POA before earning anything. Real standing accumulates slowly, like an ocean current shaping a coast, one confirmed job at a time.
